textRuns.value: Above a high threshold, fire sizes follow a generalised Pareto tail. Its shape says how slowly the chance of a bigger fire fades: at 1 or more the fitted mean is infinite and a return level means nothing, so none is published (Portugal and Greece). Each country is fitted on fire episodes above 500 ha, EFFIS, 2016 to 2025: fires within 3 days of each other count as one episode. Only EU27 countries with enough episodes are fitted. Levels stop at twice the observed period, so there is no 50-year figure. The shape depends on the threshold: pick Portugal on the map and its shape falls below 1 at the 1 000 ha threshold. Click a country on the map or a bar to draw its curves.
